name: Warrior Training Room
desc1: From the looks of this room, you are not quite sure at first if it is
desc2: a training room or armoury. After a few seconds thought, you come to
desc3: the conclusion that it is both. Mighty weapons, suitable only for a
desc4: warrior line the walls and racks of this impressing place. A large man
desc5: stands here, who is obviously a trainer.
